description: This source file implements D-Bus client functionality for managing container state changes, starting/stopping containers, and handling asynchronous D-Bus calls within the WPEFramework project. It defines callback handlers, client interface management, and D-Bus connection handling.

classes.name: DBusCallbacks
classes.description: Contains static callback functions for handling D-Bus signals and asynchronous responses.

classes.name: AsyncReadyCbData
classes.description: Holds callback data, synchronization primitives, and result state for asynchronous D-Bus calls.

classes.name: Client::Interface
classes.description: Represents a container control interface with methods to handle state changes and start/stop containers.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Main D-Bus client class managing connection, interface binding, and asynchronous operations.

methods.name: DBusCallbacks::handleStateChange
methods.description: Handles container state change signals from D-Bus.

methods.name: DBusCallbacks::asyncReady
methods.description: Handles completion of asynchronous D-Bus calls.

methods.name: Client::Interface::Interface
methods.description: Constructor initializing interface with a name.

methods.name: Client::Interface::startContainer
methods.description: Starts a container with specified command and parameters, with timeout.

methods.name: Client::connectionResetIfNeeded
methods.description: Ensures the D-Bus connection is active, reconnecting if necessary.

methods.name: Client::connect
methods.description: Establishes a D-Bus connection and sets up signal handlers.

methods.name: Client::exec
methods.description: Runs the D-Bus main loop in a separate thread.

methods.name: Client::findInterface
methods.description: Finds a bound interface by ID.

methods.name: Client::bind
methods.description: Binds an interface to the client.

methods.name: Client::unbind
methods.description: Unbinds an interface from the client.
